آتمن (form VIII)
# آتَمِنُ (ʔātaminu) /ʔaː.ta.mi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# آتَمِنَ (ʔātamina) /ʔaː.ta.mi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# آتَمِنْ (ʔātamin) /ʔaː.ta.min/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
